jobs.title: Robotics Lab Technician supporting Nvidia
jobs.description:
**Sustainable Talent** is partnering with **NVIDIA,** a global leader that has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. We are looking for a **Robotics Lab Technician** to support our client's lab operations team. This is a **full-time (W-2) contract** role based onsite in **Santa Clara, CA.** We offer competitive pay of **$30/hr - $45/hr** based on factors like experience, education, location, etc., and provide full benefits, PTO, and an amazing company culture!

  

In this role you will build, deploy, and support the hardware systems that engineers rely on every day, from bench-top development platforms to large server racks in the data center. You'll also bring ideas to life by designing and fabricating custom test fixtures and prototype components with CAD and 3D printing. This is an exciting opportunity to work hands-on with some of the most innovative technology in the world and help shape the labs where next-generation robotics and datacenter products are developed. Join us in revolutionizing the world of AI!

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Assemble, build, and install bench-top development platforms and large server systems in the bench lab and rack lab.
* Deploy systems and racks in the data center, connect power and network, and bring them up.
* Support parts replacement projects for small and large volume deployments.
* Prepare boards for detailed solder reworks to be completed by another lab.
* Connect oscilloscope probes to boards and collect signal waveform data.
* Perform mechanical reworks using power tools such as a Dremel.
* Design and produce CAD models and detailed drawings for custom test fixtures, and integrate designs into lab systems.
* Support the development, modification, and refinement of prototype components and fixtures, incorporating feedback from engineers and technicians.
* Use 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods to fabricate, adjust, and assemble CAD-designed parts.
* Run laboratory tests on prototypes and make modifications to improve functionality and performance.

  

**What We're Looking For:**

* Hands-on experience with 3D CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks, OnShape, or Fusion 360 (Creo preferred but not required).
* Experience with prototyping, 3D printing, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong proficiency with hand tools and power tools.
* Familiarity with electrical wiring and basic system integration is a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, hands-on lab environment alongside cross-functional engineering teams.

  

**About Sustainable Talent**

Sustainable Talent is a certified woman-owned company specializing in recruitment, consulting, and workforce solutions. We partner with innovative organizations to connect exceptional talent with meaningful opportunities across technology, engineering, operations, and professional services.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sustainable Talent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Client Insights
jobs.description:
**About RK Media**

RK Media is a dynamic organization representing Christian non-profit ministries who use radio, television, podcasts and digital media to reach their audience. As a full-service agency, we serve our ministry partners through the production of top-quality Bible teaching, talk and inspirational broadcasts and podcasts that include strategic fundraising campaigns and promotions. We also serve as the direct liaison between non-profit ministries, the radio stations and other outlets that carry their programs.

RK Media offers a fast-paced, collaborative work environment with potential for both personal and professional growth. We value individuals who wish to make a direct impact in the mission of Christian non-profit ministries through the media industry. We believe that when team members find value and meaning in their work, they experience success and significance. Learn more at rkmedia.co.

**The role**

We're hiring a data analyst who loves digging into numbers, telling the story behind the numbers, and wants to help ministries understand what's working.

Most of your time (~ 75%) goes to analysis: building and owning reporting for our ministry partners, managing our internal data, and creating cross-ministry benchmarks. The rest (~ 25%) is working with the people behind the requests. That means joining ministry partner calls when needed, finding out *why* someone is asking for a report, and coming back with more than they asked for.

This is a role for a self-starter. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, solves problems without waiting to be told exactly what to do, brings a "yes, and" attitude, and keeps everyone clear on expectations.

**What you'll do**

**Reporting and analysis (about 70%)**

* Take over and improve RK's current reporting for ministry partners, including monthly financial reports, station data requests, and social media analytics reports.
* Turn one-off client reports into a consistent RK reporting service that partners can rely on.
* Fully own RK's cross-ministry benchmarks, with feedback from senior leadership: what "good" looks like by channel, and how each ministry compares.
* Build those benchmarks into partner reports, so every ministry understands their experience in a broader context.
* Manage and organize RK's internal data: understand what data we have, where it lives, and how to keep it clean and usable.
* Present data-backed recommendations across various channels.
* *As recurring reporting is automated, expect more of your time to shift toward analysis and projects across RK*

**Client insight (about 20%)**

* Join client calls as needed alongside the Media Services team.
* Dig past the direct request: understand what led to it and where the ministry is headed.
* Support the account lead in assessing how a report furthers a ministry’s impact.

**Other (about 10%)**

* Take part in internal team meetings, planning sessions, and company-wide meetings.
* Keep building your skills through training, new tools, and learning the ministry media landscape, with RK’s support.
* As reporting becomes more automated, take on data projects for other RK teams, such as campaign performance analysis for Digital Marketing, station and affiliate data for Station Relations, or operational and financial analysis for leadership.
* Help find other manual processes across RK that could be simplified or automated.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll work mainly with the Media Services team, which includes Station Relations and Digital Marketing. Over time there's room to grow into work with all of our teams.

**What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days**

* You know our ministry partners, their goals, and the reports we provide each of them.
* You've taken over the current reporting process, including the quarterly social media reports.
* You've mapped what data RK has, where it lives, who owns it, and how it's collected.
* You've joined client calls with the Media Services team and built working relationships with the account leads.

**By 6 months**

* You've recommended how to elevate RK's reporting, and we've agreed on a plan.
* You've proposed a standard set of metrics and a consistent report format across ministries.
* You've set up how client data is organized and protected, so cross-ministry benchmarking can be done responsibly.
* Account leads bring you into client conversations because your recommendations go beyond the original request.

**By 1 year**

* Standardized reporting with benchmarks is running as a new service for our ministry partners, allowing them to see how their experience fits within a larger ministry context.
* RK's data and reporting processes are documented and repeatable.
* You’ve elevated reporting both internally and for our clients.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, marketing analytics, reporting, or a similar role.
* Well versed in using AI tools, such as Claude, in your daily work.
* Comfortable in Excel: pivot tables, lookups, and cleaning and combining messy data. You genuinely enjoy working in spreadsheets.
* A track record of presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Clear, concise writing — you can explain what the data means and what to do about it.
* Initiative: you find answers and solve problems without needing step-by-step direction.
* Strong communication and people skills, including asking good questions and setting clear expectations.
* Sound judgment with confidential information.
* A general understanding of Christian denominational and theological differences, and empathy for the mission of non-profit ministries.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree, or trade school or certificate training, in a related field.
* Experience with nonprofit fundraising, direct response, media buying, or donor data.
* Familiarity with radio, podcast, or social media metrics.
* Experience with SQL, or with a BI too

When you join the Teknova team, you’re helping to create the future of health. Our customers are working to discover novel therapies that will help people everywhere live longer, healthier lives. We make sure they have a reliable supply of the essential ingredients they need to succeed, and every member of our team plays an important role.

**Our Culture**:

At Teknova, our culture is all about creative problem solving, and our default answer is “Yes.” We’re customer-obsessed and go all in for them and each other. We aren’t interested in the status quo—we want to discover what’s possible. We’re bold and built to change. We go above and beyond to develop novel products that help our customers get reliable results, engineer formats that fit their systems, and find ways to ship out their orders one day sooner. Every time we help our customers work more efficiently; we bring them a step closer to that big breakthrough.

**Our Values**:

We value the unique personality and background of everyone on our team—we want you to be you. By working together and sharing our skills, we find new and better solutions for our customers. The people on our team are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re here to support them.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The QC Lab Technician is responsible for supporting the day-to-day lab functions and completing routine procedures under the direction of the Quality Control Supervisor.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supports all laboratory functions carried out by the Scientists in the QC laboratory, including but not limited to: Sample collection (raw materials from quarantine, finished good QC samples, retention samples, finished goods for retest purposes).
* Prepares the necessary sample preparation to assist in testing, including preparing solutions.
* Conduct the following QC Analysis: pH, Conductivity, Osmolality, Density and Top Spread Sterility testing.
* Testing materials or products that have various biosafety levels.
* Conducts Calibration & Temperature checks of Fridges, Freezers, and Incubators.
* Performs cleaning of all glassware and sterilizing components for routine testing (autoclaved materials, etc.).
* Disposes of samples once testing is completed.
* Aids in retention sample storage handles and drops off hazardous materials in the hazardous waste drop off location.
* Collaborates with manager, team lead and team members daily to meet testing deadlines.
* Follows all Standard Operating Procedures for assigned tasks and area.
* Responsible for maintaining appropriate training schedule as it pertains to their primary occupational duties.
* Maintains accurate inventory of materials.

**EDUCATION**

High school level chemistry or biology and / or applicable lab experience preferred

* A minimum of 1 years lab experience preferred
* Background in Chemistry, Biology or related science preferred
* Good human relations and oral/written communication skills
* Ability to perform mathematical calculations on basic dilutions and conversions
* Ability to handle multiple projects concurrently
* Ability to stand on feet for a total of 8-10 hours daily
* Must be able to carry, lift, push and pull up to 40 pounds
* Effective communication skills by conveying necessary information accurately, listening effectively

From performance bonuses that give every member of our team a chance to share in our success to health insurance and retirement savings programs to our generous PTO policy, we’re invested in our associates. Our benefits include:

* 401(k) retirement plans with a 4% employer match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Teknova wellness program
* Continuous learning opportunities
* Paid holidays, paid time off, and paid sick leave

From our scientists to our shipping department, the people who thrive here see beyond reporting lines—they are driven and open to learning something new. **Job Summary:**

The Medical Laboratory Technician is responsible for performing moderately complex and complex laboratory tests, as defined by CLIA, in hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, microbiology, and serology. California excludes MLT’s from microscopic testing and blood bank testing. Professional application of the principles, theories, techniques, and quality controls of laboratory science is used. This position reports to the lead clinical laboratory scientist, laboratory manager/supervisor, and/or the administrative director of Laboratory services. Actively and consistently contributes to department operations and communications, behaves in a manner consistent with the mission, vision, and values of Pipeline Health, upholding standards of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, Thank you) patient communication.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

* Follows the hospital’s policies and procedures and documents their review.
* Ensure all daily Quality Controls, QC, (or as required, Levy-Jennings and Westgard Rules) is acceptable before releasing patient results.
* Performs and documents all maintenance, temperatures, specimen rejection and troubleshooting, and conforms to schedules and completion of work, leaves little for the next shift.
* Performs blood smear reviews, except for manual leukocyte differentials.
* Performs urinalysis microscopy.
* Performs blood typing of moderate complexity, such as automated ABO/Rh testing and antibody screen.
* Maintains the inventory of supplies and reagents.
* Participates in the laboratories in-service and competency assessment programs.
* Help train and orient new team members.
* Uses clear, concise, professional communication with coworkers, patients, all customers internal and external.

* Completes and attends monthly training assigned.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst, Client Insights
new_jobs.description:
**About RK Media**

RK Media is a dynamic organization representing Christian non-profit ministries who use radio, television, podcasts and digital media to reach their audience. As a full-service agency, we serve our ministry partners through the production of top-quality Bible teaching, talk and inspirational broadcasts and podcasts that include strategic fundraising campaigns and promotions. We also serve as the direct liaison between non-profit ministries, the radio stations and other outlets that carry their programs.

RK Media offers a fast-paced, collaborative work environment with potential for both personal and professional growth. We value individuals who wish to make a direct impact in the mission of Christian non-profit ministries through the media industry. We believe that when team members find value and meaning in their work, they experience success and significance. Learn more at rkmedia.co.

**The role**

We're hiring a data analyst who loves digging into numbers, telling the story behind the numbers, and wants to help ministries understand what's working.

Most of your time (~ 75%) goes to analysis: building and owning reporting for our ministry partners, managing our internal data, and creating cross-ministry benchmarks. The rest (~ 25%) is working with the people behind the requests. That means joining ministry partner calls when needed, finding out *why* someone is asking for a report, and coming back with more than they asked for.

This is a role for a self-starter. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, solves problems without waiting to be told exactly what to do, brings a "yes, and" attitude, and keeps everyone clear on expectations.

**What you'll do**

**Reporting and analysis (about 70%)**

* Take over and improve RK's current reporting for ministry partners, including monthly financial reports, station data requests, and social media analytics reports.
* Turn one-off client reports into a consistent RK reporting service that partners can rely on.
* Fully own RK's cross-ministry benchmarks, with feedback from senior leadership: what "good" looks like by channel, and how each ministry compares.
* Build those benchmarks into partner reports, so every ministry understands their experience in a broader context.
* Manage and organize RK's internal data: understand what data we have, where it lives, and how to keep it clean and usable.
* Present data-backed recommendations across various channels.
* *As recurring reporting is automated, expect more of your time to shift toward analysis and projects across RK*

**Client insight (about 20%)**

* Join client calls as needed alongside the Media Services team.
* Dig past the direct request: understand what led to it and where the ministry is headed.
* Support the account lead in assessing how a report furthers a ministry’s impact.

**Other (about 10%)**

* Take part in internal team meetings, planning sessions, and company-wide meetings.
* Keep building your skills through training, new tools, and learning the ministry media landscape, with RK’s support.
* As reporting becomes more automated, take on data projects for other RK teams, such as campaign performance analysis for Digital Marketing, station and affiliate data for Station Relations, or operational and financial analysis for leadership.
* Help find other manual processes across RK that could be simplified or automated.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll work mainly with the Media Services team, which includes Station Relations and Digital Marketing. Over time there's room to grow into work with all of our teams.

**What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days**

* You know our ministry partners, their goals, and the reports we provide each of them.
* You've taken over the current reporting process, including the quarterly social media reports.
* You've mapped what data RK has, where it lives, who owns it, and how it's collected.
* You've joined client calls with the Media Services team and built working relationships with the account leads.

**By 6 months**

* You've recommended how to elevate RK's reporting, and we've agreed on a plan.
* You've proposed a standard set of metrics and a consistent report format across ministries.
* You've set up how client data is organized and protected, so cross-ministry benchmarking can be done responsibly.
* Account leads bring you into client conversations because your recommendations go beyond the original request.

**By 1 year**

* Standardized reporting with benchmarks is running as a new service for our ministry partners, allowing them to see how their experience fits within a larger ministry context.
* RK's data and reporting processes are documented and repeatable.
* You’ve elevated reporting both internally and for our clients.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, marketing analytics, reporting, or a similar role.
* Well versed in using AI tools, such as Claude, in your daily work.
* Comfortable in Excel: pivot tables, lookups, and cleaning and combining messy data. You genuinely enjoy working in spreadsheets.
* A track record of presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Clear, concise writing — you can explain what the data means and what to do about it.
* Initiative: you find answers and solve problems without needing step-by-step direction.
* Strong communication and people skills, including asking good questions and setting clear expectations.
* Sound judgment with confidential information.
* A general understanding of Christian denominational and theological differences, and empathy for the mission of non-profit ministries.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree, or trade school or certificate training, in a related field.
* Experience with nonprofit fundraising, direct response, media buying, or donor data.
* Familiarity with radio, podcast, or social media metrics.
* Experience with SQL, or with a BI too
